title: Lela language - Wikipedia
text: Lela or C'lela is a Kainji language of Nigeria. It is known as Dakarkari in the Hausa language.The Lela live mostly in Kebbi State and Niger State. However, there are also some C-Lela speakers in other parts of Nigeria, including in Gummi LGA of Zamfara State.
